svg.title: A RESTART taken whose answer is lost
svg.desc: The vehicle takes a RESTART to B; its answer is lost, but beacon 42 carries the restart flag, which says the RESTART was taken and ends the station's match. A RESTART sent again is refused NotArmed, since the first used the arm up, and restarts nothing. A station that watches the beacons refuses a START_NODE unsent from then; one that does not sends it, and the vehicle answers it Unmatched and does nothing. The new start beacons number 1 with the flag set and B's checksum.

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold

svg.text: Arrowhead: read or acted on. Cross: dropped and counted, or not acted on. The words at each end say which.
